d:
The song “KOI AUR NA HOGA” is a powerful declaration of the artist’s unique journey and dominance in hip-hop. It highlights their struggles, self-made success, and originality while emphasizing that true hip-hop is about authenticity and impact, not just fast lyrics. Confident and unapologetic, the artist claims no one else can match their style or legacy.
